g.text: −100: no loss (system, user, the assistant header, the newline after <|im_end|>, padding)

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111113

g.text: trained: the response tokens and its end-of-turn token <|im_end|>

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b

g.text: pad = <|endoftext|>, a different token from <|im_end|>, so masking pad by id leaves the end-of-turn label intact.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b

g.text: The model shifts labels by one inside the loss: the logits at position t are scored against labels[t + 1].

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #86868b

g.text: Token ids: Qwen2.5 tokenizer (Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B), real ids
